fields.summary_ko.0: Fortinet (FTNT) share price fell 26% following third quarter earnings release (October 29, pre-market), adjusted EPS of $0.91 exceeded estimates of $0.86, but specific business segment growth deteriorated.
fields.summary_ko.1: Following a year-to-date gain of 104.1% (versus S&P 500's 14.0%), Q4 guidance projects 15% growth, but close monitoring of service revenue growth momentum is warranted.
